body:
Adds `research/flex-twin` (follow-up to `backlash-twin`): a rigid-body twin of a flexible joint is stable at every PD bandwidth, but the real load-feedback loop is stable iff `ω_n < ω_n*` (exact cubic, independent of inertia ratio, ≈ ζ_s/ζ of the resonance). Includes a negative result: a short step-response validation cannot distinguish 1.1× from 0.5× the limit.

- 8 unit tests pass; `experiments/run.py` reproduces `results.txt`.
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints `ok`.
